name: Wendish Schafkopf
summary: Four-player German partnership trick-taking game with fixed Queens/Jacks as top trumps and Diamonds as trump suit.
rules_text: Wendish Schafkopf is played with 24 or 32 cards: Ace high, then 10, K, 9, 8, 7. All Queens/Obers and Jacks/Unters are permanent trumps, Queens/Obers ranking Clubs/Acorns > Spades/Leaves > Hearts > Diamonds/Bells, then Jacks/Unters same order, then Ace, 10, King etc of Diamonds/Bells. 14 trumps total. Each player gets 8 cards in two packets of 4. The two holders of Q clubs and Q spades (the Old Ones) are partners. If one player holds both, he may call a partner by naming a card (often an Ace) that partner must play ASAP, or call first trick winner as partner, or play silent solo vs three. A Lust Solo may be announced at start: soloist names trump suit. Play is clockwise, must follow suit if possible, no need to trump or win. Partnership winning 61+ card points wins; under 30 is Schneider, no tricks Schwarz.
rating_reason: Specific four-player trick game, hidden hands, strategic play
